## Synopsis

```text
perch alias remove [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Remove an alias address or catch-all from the address table. Messages already delivered are unaffected.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--address <value>` | alias address |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch alias remove --address sales@example.com
```
